approvals.scope: Every Phase 1 package and tool in this file (plan 01-01 Task 1, package legitimacy gate), approved before the first restore

Version-pinned license exceptions (plan 01-11 Task 2) for two transitive runtime packages that the SQL Server driver brings along: Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SNI.runtime 6.0.2 (Microsoft Software License Terms - Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SNI Library) and Microsoft.Identity.Client.NativeInterop 0.20.6 (Microsoft Software License Terms). Free of charge, not open source, shipped unmodified inside the app only, with Microsoft's notices kept. Only these exact versions are exempt; the machine-readable list is docs/license-exceptions.json and the license gate is tools/scripts/New-ThirdPartyNotices.ps1.

nuqs 2.10.1 (MIT) with its one dependency @standard-schema/spec 1.1.0 (MIT), planned for Phase 2 Web Foundation to keep list-page state in the URL query string (quick task 261007-kz6, requirement WEB-10). Approved after a check for npm security advisories, deprecation and the 14-day cool-down. Not installed yet, so it is recorded under planned. Switching to any other version, for example a stable 2.10.2 at least 14 days old, needs a new owner approval at install.

Security update (quick task 261014-gqz): every 10.0.12 package in Directory.Packages.props (EF Core SqlServer and Design, DataProtection.EntityFrameworkCore, JwtBearer, OpenApi, Mvc.Testing) and the dotnet-ef tool bumped to 10.0.13, plus new central pins System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs 10.0.13 and System.Security.Cryptography.Xml 10.0.13 that lift the vulnerable transitive copies (Pkcs 9.0.11 and 10.0.12, Xml 10.0.12). 10.0.13 was published 2026-10-13, so each record carries a security-fix cool-down exception. Advisories: GHSA-2fmv-rv2c-59x7, GHSA-846f-f764-76mx, GHSA-7hqp-7c5m-4vq6, GHSA-c399-9853-6jmj, GHSA-r955-8q5j-3h83. The 10.0.13 packages also move three transitive packages, approved the same day: Microsoft.Data.SqlClient 6.1.6 to 6.1.7 (published 2026-09-10, no advisories, cool-down met), Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SNI.runtime 6.0.2 to 6.0.3 (published 2026-08-14, same Microsoft license terms, no advisories; the version-pinned license exception moves to 6.0.3) and Microsoft.OpenApi 2.12.0 to 2.12.2 (published 2026-08-20, MIT, no advisories).

Phase 4 packages (D-36), approved before install: NuGet Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore 10.0.13, FluentValidation 12.1.1, MailKit 4.18.1, MimeKit 4.18.1, BouncyCastle.Cryptography 2.7.0, Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience 10.10.0 and Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.Testing 10.10.0 (tests only); npm react-hook-form 7.89.0, zod 4.6.5, @hookform/resolvers 5.9.1 and msw 3.0.1 (dev only); and the SecLists top-10k common-passwords data file that plan 04-17 adds. Identity.EntityFrameworkCore 10.0.13 is a security servicing release (D-35) and carries a cool-down exception. The four npm packages were flagged by the research seam's latest-tag and download heuristics, so they still pass a blocking human check at install time (plan 04-02 Task 2).
